blocks.raw: # Setup Localization
blocks.text: Setup Localization

blocks.raw: Orgs with an online presence (web/mobile app) in languages, other than English, need multi-lingual support to show cart promotion and store details in their preferred languages. It supports translations for both standard fields and custom fields.
blocks.text: Orgs with an online presence (web/mobile app) in languages, other than English, need multi-lingual support to show cart promotion and store details in their preferred languages. It supports translations for both standard fields and custom fields.

blocks.raw: The promotions and store details are created from the Capillary side. Hence, to show these details in a different language, you will first need to add the translation in your preferred language and then use the APIs to display it on the web or mobile app accordingly.
blocks.text: The promotions and store details are created from the Capillary side. Hence, to show these details in a different language, you will first need to add the translation in your preferred language and then use the APIs to display it on the web or mobile app accordingly.

blocks.raw:
**Limitations**\
By default, not all fields of cart promotions or stores are enabled for translation. It will require effort from development and will go through the customer request or enhancement process.
blocks.text: LimitationsBy default, not all fields of cart promotions or stores are enabled for translation. It will require effort from development and will go through the customer request or enhancement process.

blocks.raw: **Prerequisites**
blocks.text: Prerequisites

blocks.raw:
* Before configuring information in different languages, you will need to get the required languages enabled for the org.
* You will need to get the required fields (of cart promotion or stores) enabled for the org.\
  Create a JIRA ticket and assign it to the support or project management team with the complete details of the requirement. It might take 24 to 48 working hours to enable multi-language/fields for translation for an org.

blocks.raw: ### Prerequisites
blocks.text: Prerequisites

blocks.raw: Currently, we support localization (or i18n) in English and Simplified Chinese. If you want the support for any other language, you need to raise a Jira ticket (as a Task) with all the details.
blocks.text: Currently, we support localization (or i18n) in English and Simplified Chinese. If you want the support for any other language, you need to raise a Jira ticket (as a Task) with all the details.

blocks.raw: Admin access to Locize, a third party application integrated with Capillary for seamless translation.
blocks.text: Admin access to Locize, a third party application integrated with Capillary for seamless translation.

blocks.raw: ### Translation Process
blocks.text: Translation Process

blocks.raw: We use Locize, a third-party app, for the translation. Once the language is enabled from the back-end, you can start with the translation process mentioned in the following.

> Currently, we have enabled only English and Simplified Chinese. To get support for any other language, please log a task in Jira.
